routes.name: direct finite-RKHS literature shortcut
routes.retired_because: Corollary 1.12 of arxiv:1610.01997v1 does not directly apply to an infinite-diagonal PDE Green kernel. The manuscript's separate regularization and limit arguments must be checked.

C9000369.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 369 (The hot spots conjecture for simply connected planar domains.; papers: Strict hot spots and absence of interior critical points on smooth simply connected planar domains; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/369.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_RK.statement: For every bounded nonnegative subcritical disk potential and every interior p, the exact kernel D_p=K(p,s)K(p,t)/N(s,t), with diagonal zero, is conditionally negative semidefinite.

L_RK_ESTIMATES.statement: Bounded density and the strict Dirichlet form bound imply the Green contraction and the pointwise and integral finiteness of the exact chain kernels.

L_RK_REG.statement: The logarithmic-mean defect is a positive mixture of positive semidefinite disk kernels and yields bounded reciprocal-one-positive Green regularizations.

L_RK_UPDATE.statement: A nonnegative update along a column of a strictly entrywise positive matrix preserves reciprocal inertia with at most one positive eigenvalue.

C_RK_SCHUR.statement: For every finite real PSD matrix U, a>0, c>=0 and U_ii<a, the matrix U_ij/((1+ca)(1+ca-cU_ij)) is PSD.

L_RK_RESOLVENT.statement: Positive quadrature, exact column elimination and monotone Green regularization give reciprocal-one-positive interior resolvents for compactly supported subpotentials.

L_RK_BOUNDARY.statement: Radial limits at fixed compact support, followed by monotone potential exhaustion, give the correctly normalized bordered reciprocal boundary matrix.

L_RK_BORDER_CND.statement: The zero-diagonal bordered one-positive condition implies nonpositivity on the border-orthogonal hyperplane, hence the weighted conditional negativity.

C_RK_MEASURE.statement: For every finite nonnegative measure compactly supported inside the disk, with Green operator norm less than one and square-integrable Green sections at every interior point, the interior reciprocal resolvent has at most one positive eigenvalue and the boundary D_p kernel is conditionally negative semidefinite.

L_RK_COMPACT_LIMITS.statement: For compact finite measures with Green contraction and L2 Green sections, positive fixed-epsilon quadrature converges in operator norm, monotone regularization converges to the Green-chain resolvent, and the correctly scaled radial evaluations converge to the exact finite boundary chain kernels.

C_MAIN_HOTSPOTS.statement: Manuscript thm:main: every nonzero first positive Neumann eigenfunction on a bounded smooth simply connected planar domain has no interior critical point.

L_HS_VECTOR.statement: The tangent-vector variational inequality has precisely the first-eigenfunction gradients as equality space; curvature is positive on convex circles.

L_HS_REDUCTION.statement: The spectral gap, conformal regularity, multiplicity bound, boundary multiplier identity and Hilbert-distance argument supply the remaining dependencies of the full hot-spots proof; these are outside this mission's certification.

L_HS_GAP.statement: Manuscript lem:gap: the first positive Neumann eigenvalue is strictly below the first Dirichlet eigenvalue.

L_HS_CONFORMAL.statement: Manuscript lem:conformal: a conformal disk map extends to a smooth diffeomorphism of closures with nonvanishing derivative.

L_HS_WEIGHT.statement: Manuscript lem:boundary-weight: one smooth positive boundary weight annihilates all first-eigenfunction traces, and every nonzero such trace changes sign.

L_HS_NODAL.statement: Manuscript lem:nodal: a nonzero first Neumann eigenfunction has connected positive and negative sets, and its boundary trace has no four cyclically alternating strict signs.

L_HS_MULTIPLICITY.statement: Manuscript prop:multiplicity: the real first-positive-Neumann eigenspace has dimension at most two.

L_HS_CURVATURE.statement: Manuscript lem:curvature: for tangent vector fields, the divergence-curl energy equals the Cartesian gradient energy plus the boundary integral of curvature times squared length, with curvature positive on convex circles.

L_HS_MULTIPLIER.statement: Manuscript prop:multiplier: E(bg) equals one half the double integral of N(s,t)(b(s)-b(t))^2 g(s) dot g(t), for every real Lipschitz scalar b and the boundary gradient g of a first Neumann eigenfunction.

L_HS_EMBEDDING.statement: Manuscript Section 6: the conditional-negative D_p kernel admits an injective Lipschitz Hilbert-space map whose squared distances equal D_p.
